title: 哲学入门经典
description: 从古希腊到二十世纪初，一条读得下去的西方哲学主线。每本都有公版英译，可在应用内的哲学文库、Standard Ebooks 或古登堡计划免费获取。

en.title: Philosophy Classics for Beginners
en.description: A readable path through Western philosophy from ancient Greece to the early twentieth century. Every title has a public-domain English edition available free through the in-app philosophy library, Standard Ebooks or Project Gutenberg.
